India kicked off the five-match ODI series against New Zealand with a convincing 5-wicket victory in Auckland! But the biggest takeaway from the 1st ODI was not just the win — it was India's new-look pace attack.
With Jasprit Bumrah, Mohammed Siraj and Prasidh Krishna unavailable, India's relatively inexperienced bowling unit stepped up. Arshdeep Singh picked up 4 wickets, Gurnoor Brar grabbed 3, while Anshul Kamboj impressed with 2 wickets and an economical spell.
